|---|---|---|
| [Legacy Competitor A] | Expensive, slow, complex UI | 10x faster, transparent self-serve pricing |

## 7. Technology Stack & Architecture

- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
- **Backend & Database**: Server Actions, Postgres with Row Level Security, Prisma ORM.
- **Infrastructure**: Vercel Edge CDN, Stripe Billing, Supabase Auth.
- **Security & Compliance**: SOC 2 Type II roadmap, GDPR/LGPD compliant data storage.

---

## 8. Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy

- **Phase 1: Product-Led Growth (PLG)**: Self-serve developer adoption, interactive playground, open documentation.
- **Phase 2: Viral Expansion**: Team workspace invites, public shareable reports/dashboards.
- **Phase 3: Outbound & Account Expansion**: Direct outreach to mid-market teams hitting usage limits.
